title: This lint warns when volatile load/store operations (write_volatile/read_volatile) are applied to composite types.
summary: Volatile operations are typically used with memory mapped IO devices, where the precise number and ordering of load and store instructions is important because they can have side effects. This is well defined for primitive types like u32, but less well defined for structures and other composite types. In practice it’s implementation defined, and the behavior can be rustc-version dependent. Clippy puts this lint in the nursery group, at the level allow.
